text:
Maria L.: FYI — Acme (POC) kickoff Thurs 10am PT. They need higher hosted throughput for the demo and a scoped API key we can revoke after the POC. Can platform help?

Ben K.: @James R. can we do a short-lived scoped key + temporary quota increase? They expect spike to ~15 rps, ~600k tokens/day for 3 days.

James R.: Yep, doable. Need the org ID and whether the key should be restricted to generation only (no embeddings/rerank). Also whether we should whitelist IP ranges.

Priya S.: Acme asked to only allow generation and file uploads disabled. Org: acme-inc, contact: @acme-poc-rep. No static IPs on their side.

Elena SRE: For hosted POCs we usually create a key with tag `poc/<customer>/<shortid>`, TTL 7 days, rate limit override on their org, and a hard cap on token/day. Sounds right?

Sam T.: From security — scoped key + TTL is fine. Also request a short questionnaire entry recorded in the POC tracker (data retention, logs). They need GDPR note added.

James R.: Plan: create key `poc/acme/2025-03-12`, scope: `chat.generate`, TTL: 72h, qps override: 20 rps, daily token cap: 700000. I can provision if someone approves chargeback to sales sandbox.

Maria L.: Approved. Charge to sales POC budget. Please add a note on the key: `revoked-if-unused`.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-8743 for temporary quota change and key creation. Assignee: James R. ETA 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

James R.: Created the key and pushed policy. Example policy we applied:
```
{
  "key_id": "poc-acme-xyz",
  "scopes": ["chat.generate"],
  "ttl": "72h",
  "qps_limit": 20,
  "daily_token_cap": 700000,
  "notes": "poc/acme/2025-03-12 revokable"
}
```

Maria L.: Sending to Acme now. Do we need to mask the key in docs?

James R.: We never post keys in slack. I uploaded the key to the secure vault and shared access with @acme-poc-rep via ephemeral link (audit logged).

acme-poc-rep: Received the link, tests look good. Saw a couple 429s at peak around 18:04, but overall demo run fine. Thanks!

Ben K.: Noted the 429s — probably due to short bursts. We can add a small buffer in client side with exponential backoff and jitter. Also consider cache warmup for common prompts.

Elena SRE: We'll monitor token consumption. If they go >700k/day we'll get an alert and circuit-break to avoid surprise billing.

Sam T.: Security: recorded in POC tracker, GDPR note added, key will be revoked automatically in 72h unless sales requests extension.

Priya S.: If Acme asks for extension, sales to confirm expected token/day and security signoff.

Maria L.: Great, closing loop. Thanks everyone. :tada:
